what_happened.line: The Personnel Committee heard the consultant hired for a classification and compensation study of SAP and clerical positions, covering scope, timeline and cost.
The study will be paid from funds already in a town account, so no special town meeting is needed to fund it.
Members asked whether elected positions and other unions fall inside the study; the consultant is to begin November 28.
The committee agreed to return to first-Monday-of-the-month meetings at 6 PM, with Zoom and ad hoc meetings for urgent hiring.
The next meeting was set for Monday, December 5, at six o'clock; no votes were taken apart from approving prior minutes.

why_it_matters: The study sets how the town's SAP and clerical jobs are classified and paid, which feeds later personnel lines in the town budget.
Because it is paid from an existing account rather than a new appropriation, residents will not be asked to vote on its funding at a special town meeting.
